The proposed count of 13 is not justified by the argument given. The case split isn't a clean classification into families: "B(0) ≠ 0" and "gcd(Φ,B)=1" are open conditions covering many parameter values, not single families. The claim that these exhaust all regular solutions is asserted, not derived. I could not reproduce the count of 13 from the stated setup, and I don't have a reliable reference value to check it against.

VERDICT: REJECT
CONFIDENCE: 2
